formattedText.label:
Hello. This is the Movers listening test.
Look at Part 1.
Now, look at the picture.
Listen and look.

There is one example.
PAUSE 00’03”

Girl: Look, Grandma! This is the farm that we visited last summer.
Woman: I see. There are many students there. Are they all your classmates?
Girl: Yes, they are.
Woman: Who is that boy? The one wearing a hat.
Girl: The boy who’s standing on the tractor?
Woman: Yes.
Girl: That’s Jack. He loves cars and trucks.

PAUSE 00’03”
Can you see the example?
Now you listen. Drag the correct name and drop it onto the correct person in the picture.
[REPEAT FROM HERE]

R. One

Girl: Can you see the boy who’s climbing the tractor?
Woman: Oh, yes I can. It’s very dangerous.
Girl: Yes, it is. His name is Peter. He fell down a few seconds after this picture was taken. But he was fine.
Woman: Oh dear!

PAUSE 00’05”
R. Two

Woman: That girl looks frightened at something.
Girl: Yes. That’s Julia. There is a snake, can you see it, Grandma?
Woman: Oh my God! I see it now.
Girl: The farmer came and caught it right after that. Thankfully, we were all safe.
Woman: Oh. Thank God!

PAUSE 00’05”
R. Three

Woman: And who is that girl?
Girl: Which girl? The girl who’s carrying a basket full of potatoes?
Woman: No, I mean the girl who is planting flowers.
Girl: Her name is Vicky. She loves planting things. She really enjoyed her time at the farm.
Woman: That sounds great!

PAUSE 00’05”
R. Four

Girl: That boy with curly hair is called Fred. He’s the cleverest student in the class.
Woman: The boy wearing dirty clothes?
Girl: No. The boy who is swimming.
Woman: Wow! He’s swimming with the ducks.
Girl: Yes. He loves ducks, they are his favoruite animal.

PAUSE 00’05”
R. Five

Woman: I love that girl’s dress. It looks very nice on her.
Girl: Who? Is she watering the flowers?
Woman: Yes. What’s her name?
Girl: That’s Lily. I like her dress, too. She has a lot of beautiful clothes, Grandma!

PAUSE 00’05”
Now listen to Part 1 again.
PAUSE 00’03”
[REPEAT PART 1 WITH ONLY 00’03” PAUSES]
That is the end of Part 1.
PAUSE 00’05”

node.title: LISTEN. DRAG THE NAME AND DROP ONTO THE CORRECT PERSON IN THE PICTURE. THERE IS ONE EXAMPLE:

formattedText.label:
Part 2.
Listen and look.
There is one example.
PAUSE 00’03”

Woman: Hi, Lily! Where are you going?
Girl: Hi, Mrs Wilson! I’m going to my dance class which isn’t far from here.
Woman: Oh, great! How often do you go there?
Girl: I go to dance class three times a week.
Woman: Oh, great!

PAUSE 00’03”
Can you see the answer?
Now you listen and write.
[REPEAT FROM HERE]

R. One

Girl: My dance teacher is very young. She’s as young as my elder sister.
Woman: Oh, really? What’s her name?
Girl: Her full name is Jane Smith.
Woman: S-M-I-T-H, right?
Girl: Yes, that’s right. But we usually call her Janie.

PAUSE 00’05”
R. Two

Woman: How many students are there in your dance class?
Girl: Well, there are ten girls and four boys.
Woman: Wow! So fourteen students overall?
Girl: Yes, that’s correct. We all love dancing.
Woman: That’s great!

PAUSE 00’05”
R. Three

Woman: So, you must be able to dance very well.
Girl: No, I can’t. I often make a lot of mistakes during my dance class. I need more practice.
Woman: Well, if I were as young as you are, I would try learning how to dance.
Girl: You can try to do it now, Mrs Wilson!
Woman: Haha.

PAUSE 00’05”
R. Four

Woman: Is it easy to learn how to dance, Lily?
Girl: Most of the girls in my class said that dancing isn’t hard. But I find it difficult to learn how to dance well like my teacher.
Woman: Oh, I know. I can see you are trying really hard!
Girl: Thank you!

PAUSE 00’05”
R. Five

Girl: I will try my best to make my dream come true.
Woman: What’s that?
Girl: I wish that I can be a famous dancer in the future.
Woman: Wow! I believe you can make it!
Girl: Thank you! I will have to practice harder!

PAUSE 00’05”
Now listen to Part 2 again.
PAUSE 00’03”
[REPEAT PART 2 WITH ONLY 00’05” PAUSES]
That is the end of Part 2.
PAUSE 00’05”

content.text: Lily goes to her dance class three times a week.

1. Her dance teacher’s full name is Jane {{1}}

2. There are {{2}} students in the dance class.

3. Lily often makes {{3}} in the class.

4. She finds it {{4}} to learn how to dance well like her teacher.

5. She wishes to be a {{5}} dancer in the future.

formattedText.label:
Part 3.

PAUSE 00’03”

Read the question: Clare is telling Mum about the game she played at her aunt’s house. She had to find things hidden in many different places. Where did she find each of the things?

PAUSE 00’03”

Woman: Did you enjoy your time at Aunt Mary’s house?
Girl: Yes, Mum. We played an exciting game.
Woman: Oh! What game was that?
Girl: Aunt Mary hid things around her house, my cousins and I had to find them all.
Woman: Sounds interesting!
Girl: I found a CD just two minutes after the game started. It was hidden in a pirate hat in the living room.
Woman: Great!

Can you see the letter F? Now you listen and write a letter in each box.
[REPEAT FROM HERE]

R. One

Woman: What did you find next?
Girl: I found a bowl. It was hidden behind the plant on the stairs.
Woman: Haha. Was it easy to find?
Girl: Yes. Actually, that was the easiest one.

PAUSE 00’05”
R. Two

Girl: Peter found a comic book really quickly, too.
Woman: Where did he find it?
Girl: In a shopping bag in the kitchen. I walked into the kitchen before him, but I didn’t see anything.
Woman: What did you do when you found something?
Girl: We had to bring what we found to Aunt Mary and tell her where it was found. Then, we ran to find the other things.

PAUSE 00’05”
R. Three

Girl: The next thing I found was a cup of coffee.
Woman: Was it outside?
Girl: Yes, it was. It was on the balcony.
Woman: Really? That sounds too easy to find.
Girl: Yes. When I walked upstairs, I saw the cup right away. It was placed on the table there.
Woman: Good job!

PAUSE 00’05”
R. Four

Girl: There was a picture of the jungle.
Woman: Oh! I think the jungle is very beautiful.
Girl: Me too. The picture was very beautiful. Can you guess where I found it?
Woman: Was it inside or outside?
Girl: Inside.
Woman: In the bathroom?
Girl: No. I found it next to an old washing machine, in the kitchen.
Woman: Oh!

PAUSE 00’05”
R. Five

Girl: The last thing I found was a clown hat.
Woman: Where was that?
Girl: Can you think of where it might have been?
Woman: No, I can’t. There are many good places to hide something in your aunt’s house.
Girl: I found it under a blanket on the sofa.
Woman: Well, that was a good place for the hat.
Girl: Yes, it was.

PAUSE 00’05”
Now listen to Part 3 again.
PAUSE 00’03”
[REPEAT PART 3 WITH ONLY 00’03” PAUSES]
That is the end of Part 3.
PAUSE 00’05”

node.title: Clare is telling Mum about the game she played at her aunt’s house. She had to find things hidden in many different places. Where did she find each of the things? LISTEN AND WRITE A LETTER IN EACH BOX. THERE IS ONE EXAMPLE:

PAUSE 00’03”

PAUSE 00’03”

Woman: would you like any more pancakes, Jane?
Girl: No, thank you, Grandma! I’m full. We already ate dinner at 7:00 PM.
Woman: But it’s 9:30 PM now.
Girl: I also had a big soup with Dad at 8:15 PM.
Woman: Did you?
Girl: Yes, I did.

PAUSE 00’03”
R. Three. Who is the cleverest in Mrs Brown’s family?
PAUSE 00’03”

Girl: Good morning, Mrs Brown! Where are you going?
Woman: Good morning, Lily! I’m waiting for my son.
Girl: I know him. He’s very clever.
Woman: Thank you, Lily! I’ve got a daughter too. She is the cleverest in my family. I hope my son and daughter will be good doctors one day, just like their uncle.
Girl: They will, I’m sure of it!

PAUSE 00’03”
R. Four. What did Sally see first at the zoo?
PAUSE 00’03”

Girl: I went to the zoo with my family last weekend. That was a really happy day for me.
Woman: Wow! Were there many animals?
Girl: Yes, there were. I got the chance to see my favourite animal - pandas. My younger brother likes rabbits. He wanted to see them first, and we all agreed.
Woman: Yeah, rabbits are cute. I love them too.
Girl: My father likes lions. But there were no lions at the zoo.
Woman: Oh!

PAUSE 00’03”
R. Five. Where did Daisy’s mum put the pancakes?
PAUSE 00’03”

Woman: Daisy, can you bring me a plate, please?
Girl: There aren’t any plates here, Mum. Is a bowl OK?
Woman: OK. I will put some pancakes on a banana leaf. Can you help me to put those pancakes into the bowl?
Girl: Yes, Mum.
Woman: Thank you!

Now listen to Part 4 again.
PAUSE 00’03”
[REPEAT PART 4 BUT WITH NO PAUSE AFTER THE QUESTION; ONLY A PAUSE OF 00’03” AFTER THE DIALOGUE]

node.answerExplanationHTML:
1. ice skates (giày trượt băng)

Đây là đôi giày có thanh kim loại để trượt trên băng.

Đáp án là ice skates (giày trượt băng)

 

2. a lift (thang máy)

Đây là thứ dùng để đi từ tầng này sang tầng khác trong tòa nhà.

Đáp án là a lift (thang máy)

 

3. treasure (kho báu)

Đây là những thứ đáng giá rất nhiều tiền, ví dụ như vàng và tiền cổ mà cướp biển thường giấu đi.

Đáp án là treasure (kho báu)

 

4. clouds (những đám mây)

Chúng ở trên trời, màu xám hoặc trắng, và được tạo thành từ nước.

Đáp án là clouds (những đám mây)

 

5. pop stars (ngôi sao nhạc pop)

Những ca sĩ nổi tiếng trong dòng nhạc pop.

Đáp án là pop stars (ngôi sao nhạc pop)
node.answerExplanationHTMLEn:
1. ice skates

The sentence says, "These are special shoes with a thin metal bar on the bottom. People wear these to move quickly when they go skating on ice."

The answer is ice skates because they have a metal blade for skating on ice.

 

2. a lift

The sentence says, "People use this to go from one floor of a building to another."

The answer is a lift (elevator), which is used to move between floors.

 

3. treasure

The sentence says, "This is a collection of old and valuable things such as gold and diamonds."

The answer is treasure because treasure is often made up of valuable items like gold and jewels.

 

4. clouds

The sentence says, "These are in the sky. They are either grey or white and are made up of water."

The answer is clouds because clouds are formed by water droplets and can appear grey or white.

 

5. pop stars:

The sentence says, "These are singers of pop music. They are very famous and successful."

The answer is pop stars because they are famous singers in the pop music industry.

node.title: LOOK AND READ. CHOOSE THE CORRECT WORDS AND WRITE THEM ON THE LINES.

questions.title: Look. Here are the photos that I took on my holiday!
Did you enjoy your holiday?
questions.answerExplanationHTML:
1. Bạn có thích kỳ nghỉ của mình không?

Câu trả lời đúng là B. Có, chúng tôi đã có rất nhiều niềm vui. Đây là câu trả lời phù hợp cho câu hỏi về việc có thích kỳ nghỉ hay không.
questions.answerExplanationHTMLEn:
1. Did you enjoy your holiday?

The best answer is B. Yes, we had lots of fun. This is a suitable response to the question about enjoying the holiday.

Yes, we had lots of fun.

questions.title: Where did you go?
questions.answerExplanationHTML:
2. Bạn đã đi đâu?

Câu trả lời đúng là C. Đến một hòn đảo. Điều này hợp lý là một địa điểm để đi du lịch trong kỳ nghỉ.
questions.answerExplanationHTMLEn:
2. Where did you go?

The best answer is C. To an island. This makes sense as a place to go on holiday.

questions.answerExplanationHTML:

4. Bạn đã làm gì ở đó?

Câu trả lời đúng là C. Chúng tôi đi câu cá vào buổi sáng và bơi vào buổi chiều. Điều này mô tả rõ ràng các hoạt động trong kỳ nghỉ.

The best answer is C. We went fishing in the morning and swimming in the afternoon. This gives a clear description of activities during the holiday.

node.title: Daisy is talking to her friend, Paul. READ THE TEXT AND CHOOSE THE BEST ANSWER.

node.answerExplanationHTML:
1. queen (nữ hoàng):

Câu gốc: "Jim rất tò mò về lâu đài, cũng như những câu chuyện về nhà vua và nữ hoàng đã sống ở đó từ rất lâu về trước."

Giải thích: Nữ hoàng thường là người sống cùng nhà vua trong lâu đài. Các lựa chọn khác không phù hợp về nghĩa.

 

2. bus (xe buýt):

Câu gốc: "Cậu tìm kiếm trên Internet và biết rằng lâu đài không xa nhà mình và cậu có thể đi xe buýt để đến đó."

Giải thích: Jim cần một phương tiện để đi đến lâu đài, và trong các lựa chọn thì phương tiện xe buýt là phù hợp. Ngoài ra, dựa vào ngữ pháp, chúng ta có cụm “take a bus: đi xe buýt”.

 

3. walk (đi bộ):

Câu gốc: "Nhưng điểm dừng xe buýt cách xa lâu đài, vì vậy cậu phải đi bộ một đoạn đường dài để đến đó."

Giải thích: Câu này cho thấy vì điểm xe buýt cách xa nên cậu phải đi bộ thêm một đoạn. Vì vậy lựa chọn “walk” ở đây là hợp lí.

 

4. tired (mệt mỏi):

Câu gốc: "Khi đến lâu đài, cậu rất mệt nên ngồi xuống ghế bên trong lâu đài để nghỉ ngơi."

Giải thích:  Do chuyến đi dài, Jim sẽ thấy mệt mỏi. Chúng ta cần điền một tính từ mô tả cảm xúc mệt mỏi thì “tired” là phù hợp nhất.

 

5. smiled (mỉm cười):

Câu gốc: "Con quái vật mỉm cười với Jim và dẫn cậu đi qua từng căn phòng trong lâu đài, kể cho cậu nhiều câu chuyện về lịch sử của nó."

Giải thích: Chúng ta cần điền một động từ ở quá khứ đơn để đúng ngữ pháp. Trong các lựa chọn, chỉ có “smiled” là phù hợp. 

 

6. A:

Giải thích: Toàn bộ câu chuyện xoay quanh giấc mơ kỳ lạ của Jim về con quái vật thân thiện, vì thế tiêu đề phù hợp nhất là A. Jim had a weird dream (Jim có một giấc mơ kỳ lạ).
node.answerExplanationHTMLEn:
1. queen:

 "Jim was very curious about the castle, as well as the stories about the king and the queen who lived there a long time ago."

 

Explanation: The queen is typically the person who lived with the king in the castle. The other options are not relevant in meaning.

 

2. bus:

"He searched on the Internet and learnt that the castle was not far from his house and he could take a bus to get there."

 

Explanation: Jim learned that the bus was the way to reach the castle, making bus the correct answer. Additionally, according to grammar, we use the phrase "take a bus."

 

3. walk:

"But the bus stop was far away from the castle, so he had to walk a long way to get there."

 

Explanation: This passage indicates that because the bus stop was far, Jim had to walk some distance. Therefore, "walk" is the most logical choice here.

 

4. tired:

"When he got to the castle, he was really tired so he sat down on a bench inside the castle to rest."

 

Explanation: We need to use an adjective describing the feeling of tiredness, and "tired" is the most appropriate.

 

5. smiled:

"It smiled at Jim and took him to every room in the castle and told him lots of stories about the history of it."

 

Explanation: We need to fill in a verb in the past tense to be grammatically correct. Among the options, "smiled" fits best.

 

6. A

The entire story revolves around Jim’s strange dream about a friendly monster, making the best title A.

content.text:
Jim’s dad gave him a book about an old castle on his birthday. After reading the book, Jim wanted to know more about the castle, as well as the stories about the king and the (1) {{1}} who lived there a long time ago. He searched on the Internet and learnt that the castle was not far from his house and he could take a bus to get there. Last Saturday, he took a (2) {{2}} and went to the castle. But the bus stop was far away from the castle, so he had to (3) {{3}} a long way to get there. When he got to the castle, he was really (4) {{4}} so he sat down on a bench inside the castle to rest. He fell asleep and had a weird dream.
In his dream, while he was sitting on the bench, a big monster came into the castle. But it didn’t look scary at all. It (5) {{5}} at Jim and took him to every room in the castle and told him lots of stories about the history of it, even stories about the king and the queen who lived there. Then he said goodbye to Jim and flew out the window.

(6) Now choose the best name for the story

Write the letter: {{6}}
 

A. Jim had a weird dream

B. Jim’s dad visits the castle

C. Jim fights a monster

node.title: READ THE STORY. CHOOSE A WORD FROM THE BOX. WRITE THE CORRECT WORD NEXT TO NUMBERS 1–6.

node.answerExplanationHTML:
1. to (với)

"Không có răng, bạn sẽ không thể cười, ăn những món mình yêu thích, hoặc nói chuyện với người khác."

Giải thích: Giới từ "to" được dùng với động từ "talk" để chỉ việc nói chuyện với ai đó. Ở đây, hợp lý khi nói "nói chuyện với người khác."

 

2. when (khi)

"Dần dần, răng sữa của bạn rụng khi bạn ở độ tuổi từ 5 đến 6."

Giải thích: Từ "when" dùng để chỉ khoảng thời gian khi một việc gì đó xảy ra. Trong câu này, nó chỉ ra độ tuổi mà răng sữa rụng.

 

3. than (hơn)

"Có tổng cộng 32 chiếc răng trưởng thành. Nhiều hơn 12 chiếc so với tổng số răng sữa."

Giải thích: "than" dùng để so sánh. Ở đây, câu này so sánh số lượng răng trưởng thành với số lượng răng sữa.

 

4. between (giữa)

"Hầu hết mọi người có bốn chiếc răng khôn mọc ở phía sau miệng khi họ ở độ tuổi từ 17 đến 25."

Giải thích: "Between" được dùng để chỉ khoảng thời gian, trong trường hợp này là độ tuổi mà răng khôn thường mọc.

 

5. work (hoạt động)

"Các loại răng khác nhau hoạt động cùng với lưỡi và môi của bạn để giúp bạn tạo ra các âm thanh khác nhau."

Giải thích: Động từ "work" ở đây chỉ cách các loại răng hoạt động cùng nhau với các bộ phận khác của miệng (lưỡi và môi) để giúp tạo ra âm thanh.
node.answerExplanationHTMLEn:
1. to

"Without your teeth, you would not be able to smile, eat the food you love, or talk to people."

Explanation: The preposition "to" is used with "talk" to indicate who you are talking to. In this case, it makes sense to say "talk to people."

 

2. when

"Gradually, your milk teeth fall out when you are between ages 5 and 6."

Explanation: The word "when" is used to indicate a specific time period when something happens. Here, it refers to the age at which milk teeth fall out.

 

3. than

"There are 32 adult teeth in total, 12 more than the total number of milk teeth."

Explanation: "Than" is used to make comparisons. In this case, the sentence is comparing the number of adult teeth to the number of milk teeth.

 

4. between

"Most people have four wisdom teeth growing in the back of their mouth when they’re between 17 and 25 years old."

Explanation: "Between" is used to show a range of time, in this case, the age range when wisdom teeth typically grow.

 

5. work

"Different teeth work with your tongue and lips to help you form different sounds."

Explanation: The verb "work" is used here to show how different teeth function together with other parts of the mouth (tongue and lips) to help form sounds.

content.text:
Teeth are a very important part of your body. If you didn't have teeth, you would not be able to smile, eat the food you love, or talk (1) {{1}} people.
When you are a baby you get your first teeth. They are called milk teeth. Slowly, your milk teeth fall out (2) {{2}} you are between ages 5 and 6. The adult teeth then grow shortly after. There are 32 adult teeth in total. That's 12 more (3) {{3}} the total number of milk teeth. Most people have four wisdom teeth growing in the back of their mouth when they’re (4) {{4}} 17 and 25 years old. Your teeth are great for chewing, but you also need them to talk.
Different teeth (5) {{5}} with your tongue and lips to help you make different sounds.

node.answerExplanationHTML:
Tranh 1: 

1. One day, Julia ran to the beach and found a bottle in the water. (Một ngày nọ, Julia chạy ra bãi biển và tìm thấy một cái chai trong nước.)

Giải thích: Trong câu chuyện, có đoạn nói rằng, "Julia ran to the beach and saw a bottle floating in the water." (Julia chạy ra bãi biển và thấy một chiếc chai nổi trên mặt nước.) Câu này cho chúng ta biết rằng Julia đã tìm thấy một chiếc chai trong nước.

 

2. Julia thought that there was a letter inside the bottle. (Julia nghĩ rằng có một lá thư bên trong chiếc chai.)

Giải thích: Câu chuyện bao gồm đoạn đối thoại khi Julia nói,  "I don’t know. I think it’s a letter." (Tôi không biết. Tôi nghĩ đó là một lá thư.) Điều này cho thấy rõ rằng Julia nghĩ có một lá thư bên trong cái chai.

 

Picture 2:

3. When they opened the bottle, they found a treasure map in there.

(Khi họ mở chai ra, họ tìm thấy một bản đồ kho báu ở trong đó.)

Giải thích: Thông tin nằm ở câu: "Oh, it’s a map. It’s a treasure map!" Câu này cho chúng ta biết rằng khi họ mở chai ra thì bên trong là tấm bản đồ kho báu.

 

4. First, they walked one hundred steps to the north and turned right at the big coconut tree.

(Đầu tiên, họ đã đi bộ một trăm bước về phía bắc và rẽ phải tại cây dừa lớn.)

Giải thích: Thông tin nằm ở câu: "First, walk 100 steps to the north," Câu này cho chúng ta biết rằng họ đi 100 bước chân về phía Bắc.

 

5. Then they crossed the bridge, turned right again and walked straight until they saw a big round rock.

(Sau đó họ băng qua cây cầu, rẽ phải một lần nữa và đi thẳng cho đến khi thấy một tảng đá tròn lớn.)

Giải thích: Thông tin nằm ở đoạn: Now cross the bridge, turn right again and keep walking,” Charlie said, “Turn left in front of the big round rock and walk straight for 100 steps.”

Câu này cho chúng ta biết rằng họ  băng qua cây cầu, rẽ phải một lần nữa... đi thẳng 100 bước. Sau đó, họ được hướng dẫn rẽ trái trước tảng đá tròn lớn.

 

Tranh 3:

6. They followed the directions on the map that led to their house.

(Họ đã làm theo hướng dẫn trên bản đồ và nó dẫn họ về nhà của họ.)

Thông tin ở đoạn: "They followed the directions on the map and when they finished, they were standing at their house." 

Giải thích: Văn bản nói rằng, "Họ đã làm theo hướng dẫn trên bản đồ và khi kết thúc, họ đứng trước ngôi nhà của mình." Điều này cho thấy rõ ràng rằng bản đồ đã dẫn họ trở về nhà.

 

7. Charlie and Julia ate the pancakes that their dad had made and they felt happy again.

(Charlie và Julia đã ăn bánh kếp mà bố của họ đã làm và họ cảm thấy vui vẻ trở lại.)

Thông tin ở đoạn: "They ate the pancakes that their dad had made and felt happy again." 

Giải thích: Câu chuyện nói, "Họ đã ăn bánh kếp mà bố họ đã làm và cảm thấy vui vẻ trở lại." Điều này có nghĩa là những chiếc bánh kếp do bố họ làm đã giúp họ cảm thấy tốt hơn.
